title: New Bar & Lounge Opening At Former Orange County Hot Spot - NewsBreak
text:
By Allison ,
1 hours ago
It’s exciting when new businesses open in the Hudson Valley. This allows us to continue to support local business while trying something new and meeting other community members!
Hudson Valley residents have been chatting on social media about what would open in this former hot spot. Some have posted pictures of the sign on the building while others are simply guessing.
New Bar & Lounge Opening At Former Orange County Hot Spot
In Orange County, locals enjoyed visiting Whoo’s Sports Bar for food, drinks and some nightlife fun!
This Newburgh destination was a place that also brought the community together. Since they closed down, there has not been another business that reopened in this spot.
Nightlife To Return To Newburgh With New Business Opening In Former Whoo’s Sports Bar Canva, Google Maps NY Secrets Bar & Lounge is set to open in the former Whoo’s Sports Bar at 150 Route 17K in Newburgh! On their website, they shared,
“COMING SOON: Taking over Whoos Sports Bar and transforming the place for the Hudson Valley”
Also on their website, NY Secrets Bar & Lounge shared that they are looking forward to making this location a space where we can have fun, enjoy food and a nightlife experience together!
What Can We Do At NY Secrets Bar & Lounge In Newburgh When They Open? Canva, Google Maps I always love the idea of the nightlife scene. It would be great to have more clubs where we can dance and lounges that allow for a more chill experience to balance it out!
I’m excited to visit this new bar and lounge when they open in Newburgh! NY Secrets Bar & Lounge has an option to book a reservation on their website and mentioned,
“ NY’s most exclusive table experience is preparing for launch. “
According to NY Secrets Bar & Lounge, they will have upcoming events including Sunday Funday Family Day, Latin Night, Country Night and more.
Be sure to check out their website for more info and updates on their opening date!
